name: PROCEDURE_DIM_SK
comment: Unique identifier for the Procedure Dimension table. This identifies a unique record on the table.

name: DE_LOAD_EVENT_ID
comment: Data Ecosystem Load Process Event Identifier for when the row was originally created.

name: DE_LOAD_TS
comment: Data Ecosystem Load Process Start Timestamp for when the Row was originally created.

name: DE_UPDT_EVENT_ID
comment: Data Ecosystem Load Process Timestamp for when the Row was updated.

name: DE_UPDT_TS
comment: Data Ecosystem Load Timestamp - identifies when this row was created within the Data Ecosystem

name: DE_ROW_HD
comment: Data Ecosystem Hash Difference Value: A hash of the columns within a row that can be compared to a version of the row to determine if the contents have changed.

name: DE_VERSION_HD
comment:
Data Ecosystem Version Hash Difference Value: A hash of the columns within a row that can be compared to the current instance of the row to determine if a new version of a dimension is warranted(Type 2).
When the Hash VERSION is different a new row is required(new VERSION) if only the Hash DIFF changes - than and Update (SCD type 1) is in order.

name: DE_CURRENT_ROW_IND
comment: Data Ecosystem Current Row Indicator indicates that the associated row is the only �current� row for the given business key. There can be only one record with the "Y" (yes) value for the Current Record Indicator for a given business or natural key within the record.

name: DE_DELETE_IND
comment: Data Ecosystem Delete Indicator indicates if the row should be treated as a deleted row within Data Ecosystem.  Row is retained for audit purposes.

name: DE_ROW_BEGIN_DT
comment: Data Ecosystem Row Begin Date indicates the date a row became active within the Data Ecosystem.

name: DE_ROW_END_DT
comment: Data Ecosystem Row End Date indicates the date a row became inactive within the Data Ecosystem.

name: CD_SET_NM
comment: Code to identify a coding scheme from which the procedure code originated.  Valid values are ICD, HCPCS

name: PROCEDURE_CD
comment: Code to identify a healthcare service or treatment.

name: PROCEDURE_DESC
comment: Textual description associated with a procedure.

name: PROCEDURE_LONG_DESC
comment: Detailed textual description associated with a procedure.

name: SOURCE_ASSIGN_PROCEDURE_ID
comment: Source system assigned key.  This a unique identifier as assigned by the Adjudication System (MMIS).
